sources.title: Releasing Claude Instant 1.2
sources.evidence: Dated August 9, 2023; announces version 1.2 availability through the paid API, names predecessor Instant 1.1, and describes text tasks and response improvements. No parameter counts or architecture are specified.

sources.title: Prompt engineering for Claude's long context window
sources.evidence: September 23, 2023 article introduces the 100,000-token context window and explicitly identifies Instant 1.2 as the evaluated model, including tests with 70K and 95K token documents and text answers.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact claude-instant-1.2 identifier appears in the September 4, 2024 deprecation group, with November 6, 2024 retirement. The page distinguishes Anthropic platform retirement from partner-operated platforms.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models (original Claude 2 card)
sources.evidence: Page 1 describes Claude 2 and previous Claude models as using a Transformer; page 3 explicitly defines the evaluated set as Claude 1.3, Claude 2, and Claude Instant 1.1. This predates Instant 1.2 and does not disclose its architecture or counts.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models (November 21, 2023 update)
sources.evidence: Adds a Claude 2.1 appendix while retaining the original model-details text and Instant 1.1 comparison. No Instant 1.2 parameter count or exact architecture disclosure was found.

sources.title: Claude 3 model card
sources.evidence: Later-card check attempted. The official redirect target was inaccessible, and the historical CDN PDF exceeded the web reader size limit; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Its content was not used as technical evidence.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Current API terms grant service access and reserve intellectual-property rights. These June 2025 terms support the descriptive proprietary service classification but are not represented as the original 2023 contract.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Claude 3 family card with later addenda — full accessible copy
sources.evidence: Parent accessed the full 64-page combined PDF. Five exact Instant 1.2 references concern multilingual MMLU, QuALITY, discrimination and BBQ evaluations. Full-text searches disclose no Instant 1.2 total/active counts or architecture.

sources.title: Claude model pricing linked from the Instant 1.2 release
sources.evidence: The exact Instant 1.2 announcement links this one-page sheet, which lists the Instant offering with a 100,000-token context window.

name.note: Exact version named by its developer.

family.note: Claude family; Instant 1.2 is distinguished from Instant 1.1 and Claude 2.

release_date.note: Announcement explicitly says businesses can access 1.2 through the API on this date; not the earlier Instant-family launch.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: No exact-model count disclosed in accessed primary material, including the full later Claude 3 card with exact Instant 1.2 comparison tables. Research-model and sibling estimates are not transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-parameter count disclosed for Instant 1.2; no equality with total parameters is assumed.

architecture.note: The Transformer statement describes Claude 2 and previous versions, with Instant 1.1 named in the evaluated set. It is insufficient for later Instant 1.2. Exact-model first-party architecture/interpretability searches found no usable disclosure.

context_window.note: The 100,000-token context article explicitly evaluates Instant 1.2. Historical documented capacity, not evidence of an operating endpoint.

modalities.note: Release tasks and the exact-model long-document experiments establish text input and text answers.

reasoning.note: Ordinary reasoning improvements and prompted scratchpads do not establish a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode. No exact-model mode specification verified.

tool_call.note: The long-context article links a separate cookbook tool-flow demo, but does not establish native structured tool calling for Instant 1.2.

description.value: Historical Anthropic text model in the Claude Instant line, released through the API on August 9, 2023, with a 100,000-token context window. The Anthropic API model was retired on November 6, 2024.
description.note: Replaces the generic description with exact-version release, capacity and Anthropic API retirement facts.

patch.description: Historical Anthropic text model in the Claude Instant line, released through the API on August 9, 2023, with a 100,000-token context window. The Anthropic API model was retired on November 6, 2024.
patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Architecture and native reasoning/tool-calling support remain unverified for this exact revision; the original Claude 2 model card discusses Instant 1.1. Anthropic retired claude-instant-1.2 on November 6, 2024; partner platforms may have separate lifecycles.

summary: Confirms the August 9, 2023 exact-version release and text modalities; adds 100,000-token context and documented Anthropic API retirement. Parameters remain undisclosed. Architecture, dedicated reasoning mode and native tool calling remain unresolved; neither earlier Instant 1.1 architecture nor later sibling features were transferred. Parent retrieved and checked the full later Claude 3 card and launch-linked 100K pricing sheet.
